subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five public memory role slots, including per-agent overrides and hook-level role gating, as the permanent plugin and configuration contract?
rationale: Tests can validate implementation mechanics, but they cannot choose the long-term role taxonomy, inheritance semantics, or public Plugin SDK commitment.

options.title: Sponsor the role contract
options.body: Approve the five-role API in principle, then require the documentation repair, conflict resolution, and exact-head compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Land only roles with complete runtime semantics and defer dreaming or user-model ownership until their invocation protocols are defined.

options.title: Pause this architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers choose a different memory-composition model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the five-role API in principle, then require the documentation repair, conflict resolution, and exact-head compatibility proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The central files' history and canonical issue governance make this the strongest available owner for the permanent public API choice.
